explicit_validation.explanation: Both LLM (GPT-4o) and human evaluations are conducted but they are used for different purposes: LLM for automated scoring of open-ended responses (VID task) and humans for data construction/verification. No quantitative comparison or correlation analysis between LLM and human judgments is reported.

prompts.notes: Exact scoring prompts provided in Appendix tables (Tables 20, 21, 22) with detailed scoring rubrics for Video Identity Description tasks

guidelines.notes: Human evaluation used for manual screening/refinement of image edits, data construction, and verification of GPT-4o scoring results

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM (GPT-4o) used exclusively for automated scoring of open-ended responses in VID task, while humans handled data construction, quality control, and verification of LLM scoring accuracy
